name: Ellmarch Station 44 Original
description: This listing is a graded-tephra slow filter listed with throughput 115 litres an hour, operating temperature 54 degrees Celsius, feed salinity 54 parts per thousand. Its remaining stated figures are media service 1150 hours, unit price set after acceptance, energy source gravity fed. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.

reviews.title: Good, with one reservation about this listing
reviews.text: Bought this listing after a long comparison against the rest of this graded-tephra slow filter shortlist. Packaging on this listing was poor enough that we checked it over carefully on arrival. Take it as context rather than a complaint about this listing.

reviews.title: This listing after a year of steady use

reviews.title: Ours is not a heavy-duty use for this listing
